blind_spots: The GSM8K oracle covers only 16 visible fixed cases with one seed. It does not establish broad model quality.
Hardware evidence covers one TP4 V100-SXM2-32GB pod. TP8 and other hardware claims remain excluded.
SGLang, Flash-Next INT8 KV, default INT8 enablement, and image or deployment promotion remain excluded.
Declared controller, attacker, and assessor identities are self-reported. They do not authenticate an executing provider or session.
The reusable probe file names retain a call2 prefix. The call-3 execution and artifact hashes establish their current use.
payload.rationale: The exact candidate, tree, expected target, immutable call-3 ref, and corpus hash match independent local, remote, and pod observations. The corpus defines five sealed claims with executable success and falsification scenarios, pass oracles, and linked release-suite coverage. The strict decision selects the systemic band, covers five crossed boundaries, and activates material-correctness, package-boundary, and independent-role-separation floors. The pod manifest verifies all 39 call-3 artifacts, and raw summary values bind the candidate, tree, model execution, dataset, environment, extension, wheel, modules, routes, graph hashes, performance, capacity, long context, and quality results. The fresh controller-independent attacker reports 12 unique passing reattacks, two advisory findings only, no repair, and no unresolved blocker. Call-2 assurance does not support this judgment. The assessor scenario remains pending only because this assessment creates that required record.
